title: The Deity of Christ
definition: The deity of Christ means that Jesus Christ is fully God, possessing all the attributes, authority, glory, and nature of deity.
summary: Jesus is not merely a prophet, teacher, or created being. He is God the Son made flesh, worthy of worship and trust.
christFocus: Christ is the eternal Word who was with God and was God, who came to reveal and redeem.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Jesus is not merely a prophet, teacher, or created being. He is God the Son made flesh, worthy of worship and trust.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
